{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "ryanofsky",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "objected to inconsistency between single requests and batches regarding notification handling; fix pushed with ryanofsky as coauthor"
    },
    {
      "login": "fametrano",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK; tested on master with and without whitelist, suggested deciding notifications in parse() for batch fix"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:4472663469",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Handle JSON-RPC 2.0 errors directly in JSONErrorReply() rather than adding another try/catch block around parse() in httprpc.cpp",
      "quote": "it could be simpler to make JSONErrorReply() do the right thing for 2.0 requests, replacing the Assume with the behavior it asserts",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "reviewer confirmed moving logic into JSONErrorReply looks good",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4482448078"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "r:5806949337",
      "status_by_quote": "Moving the fix into JSONErrorReply() and the new test commit both look good"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4472663654",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Consider returning an error reply instead of HTTP 204 for malformed 2.0 requests without an id to comply with the JSON-RPC 2.0 spec, or clarify in test comments that returning 204 is intentional",
      "quote": "it seems like this case should get an error reply instead of 204. The JSON-RPC 2.0 spec's examples answer an invalid Request object with no id... with an error and \"id\": null",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "reviewer confirmed the fix looks right for single requests",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4484432359"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4497562530",
      "status_by_quote": "Thanks, this looks right for single requests."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4472663782",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Update the documentation table in doc/JSON-RPC-interface.md to say 'request body is not valid JSON' rather than 'request parsing error'",
      "quote": "Probably makes sense to update that documentation to say \"request body is not valid JSON\" instead, to match the behavior after this PR.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author updated the doc table in the push",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4482588364"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:5787525957",
      "status_by_quote": "update docs"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4472774752",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Expand commit message and test comments to clarify pre-PR behavior and explain why requests without an id fail to parse",
      "quote": "The test comments could explain more too. The notification case confused me most: it wasn't clear why {\"jsonrpc\": \"2.0\"} fails to parse",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "reviewer approved the approach of asserting previous behavior before the fix",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4483889331"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4497562333",
      "status_by_quote": "Thanks, this is better than what I suggested."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4497562826",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Update the documentation table in doc/JSON-RPC-interface.md to clarify that invalid requests without an id get an error reply rather than being treated as notifications",
      "quote": "The Notifications row says any request without an \"id\" field is a notification, but after this PR an invalid one gets an error reply, because the spec only counts valid Request objects as notification",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added the 'valid' qualifier to the documentation in push f27a0bc",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4517122971"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4517122971",
      "status_by_quote": "I'm just gonna throw in the qualifier \"valid\" (requests) here but if you wanna push for the whole sentence I'll add it."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4498229560",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Single requests and batches have inconsistent definitions of notifications, causing invalid 2.0 batch notifications to be dropped with HTTP 204 instead of returning an error reply",
      "quote": "After this push, single requests and batches use different definitions of a notification. {\"jsonrpc\": \"2.0\"} gets an error reply with \"id\": null, as the spec requires, but [{\"jsonrpc\": \"2.0\"}] still g",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author rebased on #36642 and pushed a commit fixing batch handling of malformed requests",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4517275774"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:6828346277",
      "status_by_quote": "fix handling of batches with malformed requests, added an extra commit with @ryanofsky as coauthor"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4498229802",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Clarify the code comment in JSONRPCReplyObj to explain that the branch handles requests without an id member, including notifications and invalid requests",
      "quote": "This comment was hard for me to follow. It doesn't say the branch is for requests that had no \"id\" member, and it doesn't mention notifications, which also get here.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author addressed in push f27a0bc",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4517156648"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4517156648",
      "status_by_quote": "Very clear thanks"
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5850624302",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Decide notifications in parse() rather than using a 'parsed' flag in the execution loop when fixing batch notification handling",
      "quote": "deciding notifications in parse(), as ryanofsky suggested, fixes both",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:5774955798",
      "verdict": "ACK",
      "reason": "fixes the crash/incorrect HTTP status on malformed JSON-RPC 2.0 requests, and makes sense to merge before #36753",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5850624302",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "confirmed that malformed 2.0 requests return HTTP 200 with error instead of HTTP 400 when tested on master with and without whitelist, and interface_rpc.py passes",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "both",
      "areas": [
        "interface_rpc.py"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Updated rc:4498229560 to fixed after the author rebased on #36642 and pushed a commit fixing malformed batch request handling.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "review rebase on master and fix for batch handling of malformed requests",
      "id": "c:6828346277"
    }
  ]
}
